JitSsh.//: Held credential for the brokered terminal. Supply via env vars so the key never lands in source control: JitSsh__PrivateKey (PEM, \n escaped), JitSsh__Username, JitSsh__Port.
JitSsh.//login: The SSH login defaults to the JIT session's own user email, because that is the account Azure creates on the VM and the one the JIT role assignment authorises. Set JitSsh__Username to force one shared account (the old 'azureuser' behaviour), or JitSsh__UsernameTemplate to reshape the email (e.g. '{email}@pam').
JitSsh.//fingerprint: Optional. When set, the broker refuses to connect unless the VM host key matches this SHA256 fingerprint, as printed by `ssh-keygen -lf`.
